mapper.insert: insert into sys_logininfor (user_name, status, ipaddr, msg, access_time, platform_source, belong_sys) values (#{userName}, #{status}, #{ipaddr}, #{msg}, sysdate(), #{platformSource}, #{belongSys})
mapper.select: select info_id, user_name, ipaddr, status, msg, access_time, platform_source, belong_sys from sys_logininfor where user_name = #{username} order by access_time desc limit 1,1
